plain_english: Oṃ. Obeisance to Consciousness-Bhairava. You who shelter in consciousness-ground: take consciousness-state, wander not in vain. Proclaiming thus — Śiva, bent on grace, conquers for devotees.
sanskrit_cite: oṃ namaś cidbhairavāya | citibhūtiṃ śrayata mā mudhā bhramata

plain_english: Consciousness-Bhairava alone — supreme, supreme-nectar-formed, one, high-blazing. All swallowed by the ring of shining faculties — Śiva I venerate.
sanskrit_cite: cidbhairavam eva paraṃ paramāmṛtarūpam | ekam atidīptam

plain_english: Praised, praiser, praise — though distinct, nothing is here. It endures: as whatever form, by consciousness-form, so becomes this.
sanskrit_cite: stutyaḥ stotā stutir iti yad api vibhinnaṃ | mṛṣati yathā yad rūpaṃ cidrūpatayā

plain_english: All-distinctions-melted, all-distinction-self, consciousness-mass-bliss — which Your principle, Lord — its imitation, Your form — I venerate.
sanskrit_cite: vigalitasarvavibhedaṃ sarvavibhedātma cidghanānandam | tasyānukṛtiṃ tvadākṛtiṃ vande

plain_english: Outline-man, man, letter-script, letter-mass — just as, just so, of varied form, You — shape reveals, supreme self.
sanskrit_cite: rekhāpuruṣaḥ puruṣaṃ varṇalipir varṇasaṃcayaṃ yadvat | tadvat vicitrarūpaṃ tvām ākāro vyanakti paramātman

plain_english: There concept-free indeed — You consciousness-formed entered — we reflect: what even a bit? Not indeed principle fancy's-object.
sanskrit_cite: tatrāvikalpam eva tvāṃ cidrūpaṃ samāviśya | vimṛśāmaḥ kim api manāṅ na hi tattvaṃ kalpanāviṣayaḥ

plain_english: Own-light made, speech-goddess, sense-flowers-offering-arranged — first-unfolding guru, then venerated, heart entered.
sanskrit_cite: svātmaprabhāṃ vidhāya vāgdevīṃ | prathamonmeṣaṃ gurum atha vanditvā hṛdayam āviśya

plain_english: I praise, reflecting, the Great Lord — self, own, consciousness-one-mass. Poured-out-bond-cluster — in this body-god-house.
sanskrit_cite: staumi vimṛśan maheśvaram ātmānaṃ svaṃ cidekaghanam | srāvitapāśakadambakam etasmin dehadevagṛhe

plain_english: Consciousness-bliss-will-cognition-action-named powers conquer, O Lord. Having got subtle-gross splits — mouth-hood, Brahma-skull-named.
sanskrit_cite: cityānandecchāvitkaraṇākhyāḥ śaktayo jayanti | sūkṣmasthūlabhidāptā vaktratvaṃ brahmamuṇḍabhidhā

plain_english: Omniscience-objected, heart and the rest, six-limbed — Yours. All up to Sadāśiva — by corpse-self — Your seat, O Lord.
sanskrit_cite: sarvajñatādiviṣayaṃ hṛdayādikam aṅgaṣaṭkaṃ te | sakalaṃ sadāśivāntaṃ pretātmatayā tavāsanaṃ svāmin
